NSCameraUsageDescription: ComClic uses the camera to take the photos of your album.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ComClic accesses your photo library to import photos into your album.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: ComClic saves the photos taken in the app to your photo library.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ComClic uses your location to show where each photo was taken.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ComClic uses the microphone to dictate your photo captions.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: ComClic transcribes your voice into text to caption your photos.
